summary: workflow archive, workflow status, sync and the cached-pricing reader all use data.db; a leftover archive.db from earlier releases is merged into data.db through SQLite (INSERT OR IGNORE, so WAL-only rows are included and existing data.db rows win), then renamed to archive.db.migrated. A failed merge warns and retries next run.
reason: Earlier releases archived into archive.db while sync wrote data.db. A file move was skipped when learning setup had already created data.db, and an ignored WAL rename failure could hide committed rows. Merging through SQLite covers both cases and never drops the legacy file before the copy commits.
validated_outcome: TestArchiveDBPathMergesLegacyArchive: data.db already exists, legacy rows still in archive.db-wal, both rows present after merge, existing row kept, legacy renamed aside, second call a no-op. Fails on the previous rename-based code.
